description: Re-pinned after the Phase 4 god-file split of FactoryPayrollTab, DailyProductionReport, FactoryBaleProductHistory and workerStatsAdvancesRoutes. No untranslated string was added: total actionable text FELL from 12,468 to 12,440. The accounting module rises 1,351 -> 1,368 purely because the bale-ledger tab panel now lives in a file whose path contains "ledger", which config/i18n-audit-policy.json classifies as accounting — the same rule that already classified the LedgerSection component beside it. Factory falls 5,409 -> 5,386 and inventory-logistics 1,488 -> 1,474 for the same reason, so the accounting rise is a reclassification and is more than offset. Detector and policy digest are unchanged and unclassified findings remain at zero.
